title: Je n'ay dueil (Johannes Okeghem)
desc: Johannes Okeghem, Je n'ay dueil. 4 voices (Superius, Tenor, Contra, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Oke3007.2); encoded by Jesse Rodin.
